rom.title_romanized: Dragon Ball Z - Chou Gokuuden - Kakusei Hen
rom.title_note: The original Japanese title is not reproduced here: repository policy keeps original-language text out of tracked files. It can be read directly from the ROM header.
rom.notes: 2 MiB LoROM (slow), ROM+RAM+battery, no expansion chip. Regions below are only those verified so far; every unlisted byte is reported as unknown on purpose.

regions.name: Reset vector stub: SEI CLD CLC XCE SEP #$30, STZ.w $4200, LDA.b #$80, STA.w $2100, JML $808012
Bank 0 extended-header lead-in, ASCII "B2A2ZJ" then padding; purpose not yet established
Bank 0 native-mode vectors are entirely $FF; the game installs its own vector table at runtime rather than using the stock LoROM vectors

text_encoding.evidence: A scan for Shift-JIS double-byte runs across the whole image yielded 159 candidate runs totalling 2236 characters, but every significant run is a repeating byte pair such as e849e849e849 rather than readable text. No genuine Shift-JIS text was found.
text_encoding.note: The character encoding is custom: possibly a flat glyph index, possibly a dictionary or compressed scheme. Rule 17 requires establishing this from evidence before any translation is attempted.

hardware_register_access.evidence: No immediate-literal references to VRAM ($2116/$2118/$2119), CGRAM ($2121), BGMODE ($2105), tilemap base ($210C), OAM DMA ($2181/$2182/$2183) or DMA destination registers ($43/$44) were found anywhere in the ROM, even though the reset stub uses plain absolute stores such as STA.w $2100.
hardware_register_access.note: Suggests hardware registers are reached indirectly, or that the access forms searched do not match this title's idiom. Static register hunting is therefore not a reliable discovery method here; dynamic tracing is the expected route.

font_regions.evidence: Rendering bank $0C at 4bpp shows Japanese character glyphs. Rendering bank $37 at 4bpp shows a dense glyph sheet of kana-like strokes and symbols whose colour indices are limited to {0, 3, 12, 15}, a four-level palette rather than the full sixteen.
font_regions.note: At least two banks appear to hold glyph data, implying a paged or indexed character system rather than a single flat font table. The character-to-tile mapping is not established. Treat both regions as candidates, not conclusions.

emulator_automation.evidence: bsnes-plus exposes no headless or batch command line; invoking it with --help launches the GUI. CDL and tracelog capture are interactive operations through the noVNC desktop.
emulator_automation.note: Dynamic analysis has no scripting path in this container. Budget for interactive work; this is the largest schedule risk in the analysis plan.
